# Tables

The Ashford extending table seats six when closed and eight when extended. Its top is oak veneer, its legs are solid oak, and its closed dimensions are 180 by 90 by 75 cm. The internal butterfly leaf extends the length to 230 cm.

# Chairs

Ashford chairs use a solid beech frame with a woven seat. Natural and smoked-oak finishes are available. Wipe spills promptly and use trivets for hot serving dishes. The table is intended for indoor residential use.
